dict.string: Osaurus uses automation to control other apps on your behalf — the built-in Notes, Mail, Messages, and Music tools you enable per agent, agents that write and run AppleScript, and plugins that use automation.
Osaurus reads, creates, and updates Calendar events only for agents you have given Calendar access to.

Osaurus uses the microphone for on-device voice transcription with FluidAudio.
Osaurus can capture screenshots and system audio only when you grant Screen Recording access.
